Q876.reason: The fee transferred title, so the property crime is false pretenses, and an unintended death after a carefully performed unjustified operation is manslaughter.

Q902.reason: Diarrhoea is measured enteric loss, whereas insensible loss is evaporation from skin and lungs and rises with fever and dry inspired oxygen.

Q905.reason: Municipal water service is proprietary, so immunity does not apply, and the duty to guard a sidewalk excavation is non-delegable.
